title: Jean Brisebarre: 'Li Restor du Paon'
bookshelves: Category: Biography, Literature and Literary studies
summary: This is a critical edition of the Restor du Paon, a poem attributed to Jean Brisebarre which was composed some time before 1338, though its exact date is uncertain. This book, originally published in paperback in 1980 under the ISBN 978-0-900547-66-9, was made Open Access in 2024 as part of the MHRA Revivals programme.
